metadata.title: Awesome Agentic Engineering
metadata.description: A practical map of tools, patterns, safety checks, and workflows for building software with coding agents.
metadata.awesomeListAttribution: Inspired by the awesome-list tradition popularized by sindresorhus/awesome; taxonomy, descriptions, and curation are original.

categories.title: Coding agents and agentic IDEs
categories.description: Tools that can inspect, edit, test, and iterate on software projects with varying levels of autonomy.

resources.name: OpenAI Codex CLI
resources.description: Terminal-based coding agent for delegating repository changes with reviewable diffs.

resources.name: Claude Code
resources.description: Agentic command-line workflow for navigating codebases, changing files, and running verification loops.

resources.name: Aider
resources.description: Pair-programming agent that edits local Git repositories through conversational requests.

resources.name: Cline
resources.description: VS Code agent extension focused on tool use, file edits, browser actions, and task execution.

resources.name: Roo Code
resources.description: VS Code coding agent with configurable modes for planning, implementation, debugging, and review.

resources.name: Continue
resources.description: Open-source AI code assistant framework for chat, autocomplete, and custom model workflows.

resources.name: Cursor
resources.description: AI-first editor combining codebase-aware chat, inline edits, and agentic implementation workflows.

resources.name: Windsurf
resources.description: Agentic development environment built around codebase context and multi-step software changes.

categories.title: Agent frameworks and orchestration
categories.description: Libraries and runtimes for building agents that plan, call tools, maintain state, and coordinate work.

resources.name: LangGraph
resources.description: Graph-based framework for stateful, controllable agents with durable execution patterns.

resources.name: AutoGen
resources.description: Framework for composing multi-agent conversations, tool calls, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

resources.name: CrewAI
resources.description: Python framework for role-based agent teams, tasks, delegation, and process-oriented automation.

resources.name: Pydantic AI
resources.description: Python agent framework emphasizing typed outputs, dependency injection, and production-friendly validation.

resources.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
resources.description: SDK for building agents with handoffs, guardrails, tracing, and structured tool execution.

resources.name: Semantic Kernel
resources.description: SDK for connecting prompts, planners, memory, and plugins into enterprise AI applications.

resources.name: LlamaIndex
resources.description: Data and agent framework for retrieval-heavy applications over documents, tools, and knowledge sources.

categories.title: Protocols, tools, and context plumbing
categories.description: Standards and utilities that make tool access, repository context, and runtime capabilities explicit.

resources.name: Model Context Protocol
resources.description: Open protocol for connecting AI systems to tools, data sources, prompts, and resources.

resources.name: OpenAPI Specification
resources.description: API description standard that helps agents understand available HTTP operations and schemas.

resources.name: JSON Schema
resources.description: Vocabulary for declaring structured data contracts used by tool inputs and agent outputs.

resources.name: Tree-sitter
resources.description: Incremental parsing toolkit useful for building reliable code navigation and context extraction.

resources.name: ast-grep
resources.description: Structural search and rewrite tool that gives agents safer code modification primitives.

resources.name: Sourcegraph Cody
resources.description: Codebase-aware assistant backed by Sourcegraph search and repository intelligence capabilities.

categories.title: Verification, evaluation, and observability
categories.description: Systems for proving agent work, measuring quality, replaying traces, and catching regressions early.

resources.name: Agent QA
resources.description: Source-available web and mobile application testing that lets coding agents author, run, and inspect natural-language regression checks through CLI or MCP.

resources.name: OpenTelemetry
resources.description: Observability standard for traces, metrics, and logs across agent and application runtimes.

resources.name: LangSmith
resources.description: Platform for tracing, evaluating, and monitoring LLM application and agent behavior.

resources.name: Arize Phoenix
resources.description: Open-source observability and evaluation tooling for LLM applications, embeddings, and agents.

resources.name: promptfoo
resources.description: Testing framework for prompts, models, and agent outputs using repeatable eval suites.

resources.name: OpenAI Evals
resources.description: Framework and registry for evaluating model behavior with reproducible task definitions.

resources.name: DeepEval
resources.description: LLM evaluation framework for correctness, faithfulness, regression tests, and CI checks.

resources.name: SWE-bench
resources.description: Benchmark for evaluating systems that solve real software engineering issues from repositories.

categories.title: Safety, governance, and secure execution
categories.description: Practices and tools for sandboxing, secret hygiene, dependency risk, and human approval boundaries.

resources.name: OpenSSF Scorecard
resources.description: Automated checks for open-source project security posture and supply-chain hygiene.

resources.name: gitleaks
resources.description: Secret scanning tool that helps prevent credentials from leaking through agent-generated commits.

resources.name: Semgrep
resources.description: Static analysis engine for finding vulnerabilities and enforcing code patterns across languages.

resources.name: OSV-Scanner
resources.description: Vulnerability scanner using OSV data to check dependencies, lockfiles, SBOMs, and containers.

resources.name: Sigstore Cosign
resources.description: Artifact signing and verification tooling for strengthening provenance in automated release pipelines.

resources.name: GitHub Actions permissions
resources.description: Documentation for limiting workflow token privileges and reducing blast radius for CI automation.

categories.title: Workflow patterns and operator playbooks
categories.description: Concrete ways to use agents responsibly inside real repositories and delivery processes.

resources.name: Stacked Git worktrees
resources.description: Git feature that supports isolated agent workspaces without dirtying established checkouts.

resources.name: Conventional Commits
resources.description: Commit message convention that makes agent changes easier to review, release, and audit.

resources.name: Keep a Changelog
resources.description: Human-readable changelog format useful for summarizing agent-produced changes clearly.

resources.name: Architecture Decision Records
resources.description: Lightweight decision records that preserve why an agent-assisted design choice was made.

resources.name: Google Engineering Practices Review Guide
resources.description: Practical review guidance that translates well to human review of agent-generated patches.

resources.name: GitHub Pull Request Reviews
resources.description: Review workflow documentation for structuring approvals, comments, and merge readiness.

categories.title: Roger's agentic engineering tools
categories.description: Local-first utilities from Roger's open-source ecosystem that support agent-led software delivery.

resources.name: repoctx
resources.description: Repository context generator for giving agents concise maps of code structure and project signals.

resources.name: branchbrief
resources.description: Branch summary tool for reviewing diffs, commits, and change intent before handoff.

resources.name: taskbrief
resources.description: Task framing helper for turning ideas into clearer scoped work packages for agents.

resources.name: workspacewire
resources.description: Workspace automation utility for coordinating repository state and agent-facing project metadata.
